# ankra_cost_budgets (Data Source)

Lists the organisation's cost budgets, largest first, with this month's projection. The counterpart of `ankra cost budgets list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cost_budgets" "all" {}

output "budgets_over" {
  value = [for budget in data.ankra_cost_budgets.all.budgets : budget.name if budget.status == "over"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `budgets` (Attributes List) Budgets in the organisation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--budgets))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `is_partial` (Boolean) Whether the token could not list the whole organisation, so only its own project's budgets are listed and organisation, environment and other-project budgets are missing.

<a id="nestedatt--budgets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `budgets`

Read-Only:

- `currency` (String) Currency of the budget.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the budget.
- `month_to_date_cents` (Number) Spend so far this month; null while nothing in scope is priced.
- `monthly_cents` (Number) Monthly budget in cents of `currency`.
- `name` (String) Budget name.
- `notify_at_pct` (Number) Percent of the budget at which the owner is told.
- `owner_user_id` (String) Ankra user id of the owner, if any.
- `projected_month_end_cents` (Number) Projected spend at month end; null while nothing in scope is priced.
- `scope_id` (String) Scope id or environment label; null for the organisation.
- `scope_kind` (String) `organisation`, `project`, `cluster`, `environment` or `application`.
- `scope_name` (String) Display name of the scope.
- `status` (String) This month: `under`, `approaching`, `crossing`, `over` or `unknown`.
